_comment: Benchmark ratchet floors in nanoseconds (ADR 0049, T5). `make bench` runs the criterion kernels then fails if any median exceeds its floor by more than the ratchet tolerance (1.6x). PERIODIC and machine-dependent — never part of `make check`. These were captured on the WSL2 reference machine; update deliberately when hardware or a kernel legitimately changes (the ratchet prints suggestions when a kernel gets faster).
